# AJ Travels - Pune & Mumbai Intercity Cab & Car Rental Agency

> AJ Travels (AJ Tours & Travels Pune) is a premier vehicle rental agency headquartered in Pune, Maharashtra. We provide verified chauffeur-driven car rentals, 24/7 Pune-to-Mumbai expressway taxi services, airport transfers (CSMIA Mumbai BOM & Pune PNQ), outstation sightseeing tours, corporate car rentals, and luxury group Tempo Travellers across Western India.

## Core Services & Booking Links
- [Pune to Mumbai Cab Service](https://www.ajtravelspune.com/services/pune-mumbai-cab): 24/7 one-way and round-trip transfers along the Mumbai-Pune Expressway with door-to-door pickup and all expressway tolls included.
- [Mumbai to Pune Cab Service](https://www.ajtravelspune.com/services/mumbai-pune-cab): Punctual return transfers from Mumbai, Thane, Navi Mumbai, and BKC to Pune and PCMC.
- [Airport Transfers (BOM / PNQ)](https://www.ajtravelspune.com/services/airport-transfers): Dedicated flight-tracked airport pickups and drop-offs to Chhatrapati Shivaji Maharaj International Airport (Terminals 1 & 2) and Pune International Airport.
- [Outstation Car Rental](https://www.ajtravelspune.com/services/outstation): Chauffeur-driven outstation cabs to Mahabaleshwar, Panchgani, Lonavala, Khandala, Shirdi, Lavasa, and Goa with experienced highway drivers.
- [Corporate Car Rental](https://www.ajtravelspune.com/services/corporate): Dedicated corporate vehicle rental services, executive sedans, GST compliant invoicing, and customized monthly travel plans.
- [Tempo Traveller Hire](https://www.ajtravelspune.com/services/tempo-traveller): 12, 17, 20, and 26-seater luxury Tempo Travellers for group tours, weddings, corporate outings, and family pilgrimages.
